limitations: Denominator is the 24 designs selected per family, not all generations; the filter is described qualitatively.
Binary active or inactive scoring; no replicate count, uncertainty or activity level is printed.
A single assay format per family; the source also reports control tests of natural elements, which are not counts over designs and are not extracted.
Figures 4E to J and fig. S21 carry the per-design evidence; no per-design table of outcomes is printed.

limitations: PubMed Central author manuscript, not the publisher's typeset article; wording and figure numbering follow the accepted manuscript.

The supplementary material could not be retrieved: the Science supplement URL returned HTTP 403 and Europe PMC reports PMC12057570 as not open access, so the supplementary tables and figures were not checked.

Quantitative generation metrics in this paper are figures (generated-sequence coding density, protein pLDDT and identity distributions, tetranucleotide usage deviations, stop-codon frequencies, perplexity scaling). No printed numbers for them, so they are not extracted.

The in vitro counts extracted here are a wet-lab outcome for a selected, filtered subset of generated designs, not a benchmark score on a held-out dataset; the selection pipeline is a filter chosen by the authors.
